 Rename note.txt to notes.txt

 Context

 note.txt sits untracked in /private/tmp/aw-sandbox (git status: ?? note.txt). The goal is to rename it to notes.txt. Nothing else references
 it, so no other files change.

 Steps

 1. Check the target is free. Run ls notes.txt in /private/tmp/aw-sandbox. It should report "No such file". A plain mv would silently overwrite
    an existing notes.txt.
 2. Rename the file. Run mv -n note.txt notes.txt. Use plain mv, not git mv, because the file is untracked. The -n flag refuses to overwrite as
    a second safeguard.

 Verification

 - ls note.txt notes.txt shows only notes.txt.
 - git status --short shows ?? notes.txt and no note.txt.

 No commit is included, since none was requested.
